summary: Kimchi fried rice (kimchi bokkeumbap) is cooked over maximum heat from cold, day-old rice and drained, chopped kimchi, finished with sesame oil and salt and topped with an optional fried egg.
glance: 2 as a one-dish meal or 3 as a side dish
3 cups cooked, refrigerated rice (day old is best)
Vegetarian; vegan without the egg; check the kimchi for seafood and gluten
yield: 2 as a one-dish meal or 3 as a side dish
faq: Why does kimchi fried rice need cold rice?
Use rice that has cooled overnight, or at least a couple of hours in the refrigerator. Otherwise you'll have mush.
How do you get crispy rice in fried rice?
Cook it over high heat, tossing only occasionally so the rice stays in contact with the pan and browns. The longer you can let it cook, the more crispy-crusted rice you get.
How should I prepare the kimchi?
Squeeze out most of the liquid so it doesn't make the rice soggy, and chop it into thin strips. Koreans usually use kimchi that is starting to get overripe, but normal jarred kimchi is fine.
Is kimchi fried rice vegetarian?
Yes, but check the kimchi's ingredients for one that doesn't contain seafood. For vegan, double-check the kimchi and omit the egg; for gluten-free, double-check the kimchi.
Does Korean kimchi fried rice have egg?
It doesn't generally contain scrambled egg, but there can be a fried egg with a soft yolk on top, which the diner breaks to enrich the rice.
Can I add other vegetables or tofu?
Yes, a modest amount of finely cut vegetables or tofu. Cook raw ones before adding the rice; already-cooked ones can go in with the kimchi.

summary: Baked custard from just eggs, whole milk, sugar, vanilla and salt: strain it twice, bake in ramekins in a hot water bath at 350°F for about 20 minutes, and pull it while it still jiggles.
glance: 350°F for about 20 minutes, until just barely set
faq: How do you keep baked custard smooth?
Thoroughly strain the base before baking, bake in a hot water bath to moderate the temperature, and don't overbake. Those three steps prevent grainy, scrambled-egg custard.
How do you strain custard?
Nest a coarse strainer over a fine one and pour once, rather than pouring back and forth between them.
How do I know when baked custard is done?
After about 20 minutes it should be just barely set. A toothpick should come out nearly clean, with a visible jiggle when you move the pan. Err on the side of undercooking.
How do I make a richer custard?
Replace up to two-thirds of the milk with heavy cream, or use 10 egg yolks instead of 8 whole eggs for an eggier, richer taste.
How can I flavor baked custard?

Vanilla extract is in the recipe, but you can use a scraped vanilla bean with the pod infused in the milk, or espresso, fresh ginger, rosewater, lemongrass, bay leaf, citrus zest or herbs. Non-liquid flavorings should steep off the heat until strong enough.
Can I make creme brulee from this?
Make the rich version, scatter sugar on top and hit it with a blowtorch.

summary: Quick green apple "kimchi" is unfermented: julienned apple tossed by hand with onion, ginger, salt, gochugaru and rice vinegar, kept in the refrigerator and eaten within a couple of hours.
glance: refrigerated; use within a couple of hours or it gets soggy

summary: Kala chana is a guest recipe from Amee of Rabbit Food Rocks: black chickpeas soaked overnight, pressure-cooked, then simmered 20 minutes in a spiced onion and tomato masala.
glance: pressure cook 12 minutes (3 whistles), or about 1 hour 15 minutes in a pot; then simmer 20 minutes
faq: What is kala chana?
Black chickpea curry, a hearty, warming, aromatic homestyle Indian bean dish, much like a vegetarian bean-based chili.
Do black chickpeas need to be soaked?
Yes. They have a tough skin and are very dense, so soaking overnight is a must. This recipe soaks them with baking soda.
Can I make kala chana without a pressure cooker?
Yes. After soaking, rinse and replace the water and cook on medium heat for an hour and 15 minutes, keeping the water at least 1 inch above the beans.
Can I use regular chickpeas?
Yes, regular dried chickpeas work if you can't find kala chana.
What do you serve with kala chana?
Rice, or flatbread, parathas or naan. It is often accompanied by kadhi, a yogurt-based soup.
What can I use instead of ginger-garlic paste?
One inch of grated ginger plus 5 cloves of crushed, finely diced garlic.

summary: Jjolmyeon (bibim naengmyeon) is chewy sweet potato starch noodles served ice cold in a thin, spicy kochujang sauce with chilled vegetable toppings such as asparagus, carrot and cucumber.
glance: 12 ounces sweet potato starch noodles (jjolmyeon, or naengmyeon)
faq: What is jjolmyeon?

Bibim naengmyeon, correctly called jjolmyeon, is a dish of very chewy sweet potato starch noodles in a spicy, thin, ice cold sauce with ice cold, thinly sliced vegetables. Jjol noodles started as a factory mistake: noodles made too thick and chewy that became a hit.
Why must the noodles be ice cold?

Cold is what makes the dish great. The bowls are chilled, the sauce is cold, and the noodles and vegetables go through an ice bath, which also gives them a snappy texture. Served room temperature, it won't be the same.
What noodles can I use?
Korean sweet potato starch noodles: jjolmyeon first, naengmyeon as a very good second choice. The same kind of noodle is used in japchae.
What toppings go on jjolmyeon?

Traditionally cucumber and carrot, sometimes half a hard-boiled egg. This version adds blanched asparagus tips, shaved asparagus stems, radish sprouts and lotus root. Shredded lettuce, bean sprouts or pickled daikon would also work.
How do you make the sauce?

Whisk kochujang, mirin, rice vinegar, salt and grated ginger, then whisk in up to 1/2 cup ice cold water to a thin consistency. Add the rest of the kochujang to taste, and refrigerate or freeze until serving.
Is jjolmyeon vegan?
Yes as written: vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free.

summary: Tomato and beet salad: equal volumes of ripe tomato wedges and boiled, cooled beets tossed with fruity olive oil and flaky salt, then topped with crumbled feta and fresh mint.
glance: 3 cups tomato wedges to 3 cups boiled beet wedges
boil and cool the beets a day or two before
Vegetarian and gluten-free; vegan if you omit or substitute the feta
faq: How do you boil beets for a salad?

Leave the peel on and keep the root and a little bit of stem intact, which reduces bleeding into the pot. Test for doneness by poking with a knife or cake tester. When tender, let them cool completely and slip the jackets right off.
Can I make tomato and beet salad ahead?
You can boil the beets a day or two before. The author makes a bunch and uses them for several days. Toss with the tomatoes and serve immediately.
Can I use canned beets?
No. The salad depends on great tomatoes, great olive oil and home-cooked beets, and the author says not to use canned.
Can I roast the beets instead?
Yes, roasted beets would be fine in this salad.
What herbs can I use instead of mint?
Experiment with thyme, oregano, tarragon or chives.
Is tomato and beet salad vegan?
It is vegetarian and gluten-free as written, and vegan if you omit the feta or substitute for it.

summary: Pear-caramel ice cream, summarized from David Lebovitz's The Perfect Scoop: diced pears cooked in deep-amber caramel for ten minutes, mixed with cream, pureed, strained and churned; makes about 1 quart.
glance: sugar cooked to a deep amber, then pears cooked 10 minutes

summary: A vegetarian panna cotta set with just 2 grams of agar: roasted caramelized bananas, buttermilk and cream are blended, strained, heated to a simmer, and chilled at least two hours, then served with a bourbon brown sugar syrup.
glance: Vegetarian and gluten-free; vegan version with coconut milk is untested
faq: How do you make panna cotta without gelatin?

Use agar-agar. Because agar makes brittle gels at high concentrations, this recipe starts with an already thick base of buttermilk, cream and caramelized banana puree, so only 0.2% agar by weight is needed for a creamy, wiggly result.
How do you keep agar from clumping?
Disperse it before it hydrates: whisk it with sugar, sprinkle it into the vortex of liquid in a running blender, and only then heat it. Heating before dispersing gives a clumpy mess.
Which agar brand should I use?

The author likes Telephone brand, sold in little packets at Asian groceries: completely flavorless and reliably strong. Other brands or agar flakes may need experimenting to find the equivalent amount.
How do I unmold vegetarian panna cotta?
Use metal or silicone molds, dip the base in hot water for a few seconds, dry it and invert onto a plate. Serving in the ramekins is the safest option.
Can I make it vegan?
The author suggests trying coconut milk and cream in place of the dairy, perhaps with a mango sauce, but hasn't tried it.
How long does panna cotta need to chill?
At least two hours in the refrigerator, covered with foil.

summary: Methi dal is a guest recipe from Sala Kannan of Veggie Belly: red lentils simmered about 12 minutes with cumin, chili, onion, ginger, garlic and turmeric, with fresh fenugreek stirred in for the last 2 minutes.
glance: 1 cup fresh, added for the last 2 minutes
steamed rice, roti, chapati, naan or tomato rice
faq: What is methi dal?
A mild Indian red lentil dal with fresh fenugreek (methi), a herb with a pleasantly bitter taste. Dal and rice is a humble, comforting everyday meal in India.
What can I use instead of fresh fenugreek?
Substitute 2 tablespoons of dried fenugreek or 1 cup of fresh spinach, or both.
When do I add the fenugreek?
The leaves wilt easily, so stir them in when the dal is almost done and boil for 2 minutes.
Can I use other lentils?
Yes, any kind of lentils works. Red lentils give the best color and texture here, and cooking time may vary depending on the lentil.
What do you serve with methi dal?
Serve it as a soup, or as a main dish with steamed rice or Indian flatbread like rotis, chappatis or naan. The author's favorite accompaniment is South Indian tomato rice.
Is methi dal vegan?
Yes if you use canola oil rather than ghee. It is vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free as written.

summary: A compressed cantaloupe and cucumber salad: frozen and defrosted melon and cucumber slabs are wrung out into translucent "noodles" with sesame and umeboshi, served with sake infused with shiso in a cream whipper in about 2 minutes.
glance: 15 minutes, after freezing and defrosting the cucumber and melon in advance
Dave Arnold's cream-whipper infusion, charged with one NO2 cartridge
faq: How do you infuse sake with shiso?

Lightly crush ten shiso leaves, put them with 1 cup of sake in a cream whipper, charge with one NO2 cartridge, shake 30 seconds and let stand 1 minute. Discharge the gas, strain, and chill the sake in the freezer for ten minutes.
How does the cream whipper infusion work?
The NO2 forces its way into the plant cells, then rushes out when released, carrying flavor components into the liquid. It takes two minutes and needs no special culinary talent.
How do you compress cucumber and melon at home?

Restaurants use a vacuum chamber. At home, freeze the fruit overnight and then thaw it: the melon becomes flexible enough to bend and wring water out of without breaking. Cucumbers, which are closely related, work too.
What does shiso taste like?
Shiso, also called perilla or beefsteak leaf, tastes somewhat like mint or basil with a distinctly tart edge. In Japan it is classically paired with pickled umeboshi plums.
Is it vegan?
Yes. It is vegetarian, vegan and gluten-free, and serves 4.
